items.title: Dark CSS tokens + body gradient
steps: Open app; inspect html.dark and CSS vars.
Confirm body uses dark radial gradient.
items.expected: All token-driven surfaces invert to dark B&W palette; body gradient is dark.
items.evidence: -tw CDP 2026-07-28: hasDarkClass=true, --background=#0a0a0a, --foreground=#fafafa, bodyBg starts with dark radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,...)). Screenshot confirmed dark UI.

items.title: FOUC guard + theme bootstrap
steps: Confirm first paint is dark (toggle label Switch to light mode).
items.expected: Dark mode applied before React hydrates; no visible flash of light theme.
items.evidence: -tw 2026-07-28: set socmed-theme=dark then navigate; page loaded dark with aria-label Switch to light mode. Inline FOUC script present in frontend/index.html.

items.title: ThemeContext + useTheme
items.expected: Theme state, DOM class, and localStorage stay in sync across toggle and reload.
items.evidence: -tw CDP: after click hasDarkClass=false, themeStorage=light, bg=#fff, label Switch to dark mode; after set dark + reload restored dark.

items.title: Header ThemeToggle placement
steps: Signed-in: confirm Profile → toggle → Log out in AppShell.
items.expected: Toggle between Profile and Log out when authenticated; before Sign in when logged out.
items.evidence: Signed-out -tw CDP navLabels: [Feed, Switch to light mode, Sign in]. Authenticated order verified in AppShell.tsx (ThemeToggle between Profile and Log out).
items.waiver: Live signed-in browser click was interrupted during -tw (session cut mid-register). Authenticated placement re-confirmed by source inspection of AppShell.tsx; signed-out live order passed. Explicit waiver per PR review item 6.

items.title: Cross-page dark mode coverage
items.expected: No page stuck in light-only styling.
items.evidence: -tw screenshots: feed home inverted in dark and light via shared CSS tokens on :root/.dark; all pages consume same token set.
items.notes: Spot-checked /; login/friends/profile share AppShell + index.css tokens.
